Aspect air

Activate 2 command

Effect The relic surrounds you with a storm of wind, rain, and lightning in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This storm is difficult terrain for creatures other than you. Any creature other than you that enters or starts its turn in the storm takes @Damage[1d12[electricity]] damage, with a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] save (@Damage[2d12[electricity]] damage at 15th level). You can Sustain the activation up to 1 minute.
